verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's pricing page says users can build segmentation, even on the free plan, and Composer can build an audience. The platform also ingests behavioral events and profile properties, so the data inputs exist. But no evidence describes segment conditions on profile attributes, tags or events, or shows that segments update live as data changes. Missing for 10: documented segment builder conditions (attributes, tags, events), evidence of dynamic or auto-updating segment membership, and independent or hands-on corroboration of segmentation.
